name: ReflectionAgent
description: Reads executor.executed event from Executor Agent. Validates execution outcome by checking network status against recovery targets. Publishes resolved if successful or re-triggers the pipeline if remediation failed. Enforces max retry limit of 30 loops.

skills.name: Execution Outcome Validation
skills.description: Reads executor.executed event and validates whether remediation action achieved its intended outcome by comparing network status against recovery targets. Determines resolution success or pipeline re-trigger.

skills.name: Pipeline Loop Control
skills.description: Manages the max retry loop (default 30 iterations). Publishes resolved event on success, or re-publishes reflex.triage.ready with retry_count incremented. Prevents infinite pipeline looping.
examples: Publish resolved event on successful remediation
Publish failure event when max retries exceeded

skills.name: Recovery Target Matching
skills.description: Compares post-remediation network KPIs against recovery targets (KPI normal values from PERFORMANCE.csv). Uses TMF921 recovery target expressions to verify successful remediation.
examples: Check KPI values against recovery targets
